bioconda.name: r-doubletfinder
bioconda.summary: Doublet detection in single-cell RNA sequencing data using artificial nearest neighbors.
bioconda.description:
DoubletFinder identifies doublets by generating artificial doublets from an
existing scRNA-seq dataset and finding the real cells that preferentially
co-localize with them in gene expression space. The package also provides
the pN-pK parameter sweep used to select pK, and a homotypic doublet
proportion estimate from cell annotation frequencies.
